title: IM closure in ℝ^P from local liminf mass bounds (V4(ii), steps 9–11)
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and assume CL(d): for all P ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and currents T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_d(U) (j ∈ ℕ) such that every T_j is integer multiplicity (IM), sup_j (M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U, and T_j ⇀ T in U, the current T is IM. Assume (LOC), the exact conclusion of the sibling theorem cbr_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_local (its hypotheses (REP), (MR), (IMC) are discharged by the parent): for all P, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every X ∈ 𝒟_k(U), (1) if M_W(X) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U, and every x ∈ U has r > 0 with B_r(x) ⊆ U such that the domain restriction X|_{B_r(x)} = X.restrictDomain ∈ 𝒟_k(B_r(x)) is IM, then X is IM; (2) for every open V ⊆ U, if X is IM then X|_V ∈ 𝒟_k(V) is IM. Let P ∈ ℕ and Z_i, Z ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ) with every Z_i IM and Z_i ⇀ Z in ℝ^P. Suppose that for every k ∈ ℕ, with W_k := B_{k+1}(0) (open ball), liminf_{i→∞} (M_{W_k}(Z_i) + boundaryMassOn(Z_i, W_k)) < ∞ in [0, ∞], where boundaryMassOn(Y, W) := M_W(∂Y) if d ≥ 1 and := 0 if d = 0. Then Z is IM.
lean_statement: ∀ d : ℕ, (∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsOpen U → ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → X.massOn W < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ h : ball x r ⊆ U, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X.restrictDomain h)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X) ∧ (∀ (V : Set (Euclid P)) (h : V ⊆ U), IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (X.restrictDomain h))) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (Zs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Zs i)) → WeaklyConvergesOn Zs Z → (∀ k : ℕ, liminf (fun i => (Zs i).massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) ((k : ℝ) + 1)) + boundaryMassOn (Zs i) (ball (0 : Euclid P) ((k : ℝ) + 1))) atTop < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z
